Title: General availability: Azure Kubernetes Service in South Africa North

Body.Content:
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is now generally available in South Africa North. This brings AKS to 25 Azure regions. In the list of regions, you can see where AKS is available and where it's coming next.

AKS offers a fully managed Kubernetes environment on Azure. It enables customers to spend less time managing infrastructure and more time building applications. To learn more, check out the AKS product page and documentation.
